title: The influence of different regulatory patterns of miRNA-target genes on the pigmentation of the Chinese soft-shelled turtle (Pelodiscus sinensis)
task: Elucidate miRNA regulatory mechanisms controlling pigmentation in Chinese soft-shelled turtles
key_results: miR-18a-3p_3 directly targets Sox10 3'UTR; miR-221 directly targets Mitf 3'UTR; miRNA modulators alter downstream melanogenic gene expression (Tyr, Tyrp1, Gpnmb) in primary melanocytes and turtle tissues
comments: The study effectively validates miRNA-target interactions but acknowledges tissue-specific regulatory complexity that may limit generalizability of in vitro findings to whole-organism pigmentation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: miR-18a-3p_3 negatively regulates Sox10 expression in melanocytes
hypotheses.result: Antagomir treatment increased Sox10 expression and downstream melanogenic genes in vitro; confirmed in vivo but with context-dependent variation

hypotheses.hypothesis: miR-221 positively regulates Mitf expression in melanocytes
hypotheses.result: Agomir treatment modulated Mitf and downstream melanogenic gene expression; tissue-specific differences observed in vivo

title: SkinFormer: a hybrid vision transformer and ConvNeXtV2 approach for skin cancer detection and segmentation
task: Skin lesion classification and segmentation for melanoma detection
key_results: Achieved 96.8% accuracy, 0.985 AUC, 95.8% F1-score for benign/malignant classification; segmentation Dice coefficient 95.6%
comments: Hybrid Vision Transformer architecture shows strong clinical interpretability through attention heatmaps, though validation on truly prospective data would strengthen claims.

inputs: ISIC 2024 and DermQuest skin lesion images (55,000+)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration of global context and local texture improves classification of irregular borders and low-contrast lesions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via ablation studies and qualitative visualizations

title: Evaluating large language model`s performance in answering principles of health course questions
task: Evaluation of large language model performance on health course questions
key_results: ChatGPT-4o and Perplexity achieved highest accuracy (0.93); all LLMs showed perfect sensitivity (1.0); performance declined with question complexity and verbosity
comments: Performance metrics indicate LLMs struggle with quantitative/numerical reasoning; findings suggest need for domain-specific fine-tuning before clinical deployment.

inputs: Principles of Health course questions (varying complexity)

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM performance degrades with increasing question complexity and length
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; specific weakness in quantitative questions observed

title: cfDECOR: a novel approach for estimating cell type contributions to cfDNA based on chromatin accessibility patterns
task: Deconvolution of cell-free DNA to infer tissue-of-origin composition
key_results: cfDECOR deconvolution model successfully predicts cell type contributions to cfDNA using chromatin accessibility patterns; improves disease detection accuracy and sensitivity
comments: Novel use of ATAC-seq-derived signatures for cfDNA deconvolution; clinical utility depends on validating tissue-specific accessibility patterns across diverse disease states.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chromatin accessibility patterns in cfDNA reflect tissue/cell type origins and can improve disease detection
hypotheses.result: Proof-of-concept evidence provided; full validation pending

title: Application of nanopore adaptive sampling for metagenomic detection of tick-borne RNA viruses
task: Metagenomic detection of tick-borne RNA viruses using nanopore adaptive sampling
key_results: Successfully assembled Dabieshan tick virus genomes from single ticks with high-resolution sequences; confirmed DTV presence in Republic of Korea with phylogenetic clustering to China/Japan isolates
comments: NAS effectively overcomes host DNA contamination and low viral abundance limitations, enabling practical surveillance of emerging pathogens in endemic regions.

model_io.model: Nanopore adaptive sampling (NAS) with long-read sequencing

hypotheses.hypothesis: NAS improves genome assembly from low-abundance viral RNA compared to conventional nanopore workflows
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; NAS effective even under suboptimal fragment-size conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: DTV circulates regionally via H. longicornis distribution
hypotheses.result: Supported; detected sequences cluster with China and Japan isolates

title: A machine learning-driven framework integrating cell death and senescence signatures for multi-target drug design and immunotherapy optimization in ovarian cancer
task: Integrating cell death/senescence signatures for ovarian cancer drug design and immunotherapy optimization
key_results: CDSLS signature predicts immunosuppression and poor survival; RB1 overexpression induces senescence, enhances CD8+ T cell activation, restrains tumor growth in vivo; AI-predicted compounds (e.g., ZINC001175043471) target RB1
comments: Multi-omics integration including scRNA-seq strengthens target identification; functional validation of RB1 is thorough, though clinical translation of predicted compounds requires further development.

model_io.model: Machine learning-driven Cell Death and Senescence Learning Signature (CDSLS)

hypotheses.hypothesis: RB1 regulates senescence and immune activation in ovarian cancer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RB1 overexpression induces senescence and enhances CD8+ infiltration in vivo

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cell death/senescence signatures improve immunotherapy response prediction
hypotheses.result: Supported; CDSLS correlates with survival and immunosuppression phenotypes

title: A new perspective on data leakage prevention and adaptive attention in telecom churn prediction
task: Telecom churn prediction with leakage-free preprocessing and hierarchical feature interaction modeling
key_results: 96% accuracy and 3% Brier score on telecom datasets; statistically significant improvements with p-values < 5% vs. baselines
comments: The emphasis on data leakage prevention during resampling is practical and underexplored, though the novelty of LOP-Attention beyond standard attention mechanisms remains somewhat incremental.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Data leakage from preprocessing before splitting inflates reported model performance
hypotheses.result: Leakage-free protocol with Auto Balance provides statistically reliable, lower but more honest estimates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-level nonlinear feature interactions improve churn prediction over standard architectures
hypotheses.result: LOP-Net outperforms baselines with 96% accuracy and robust variance across random seeds

title: LiRPE 1.0: a modified linformer with relational positional encoding for network intrusion detection
task: Network intrusion detection with efficient transformer-based classification and explainability
key_results: 99.51% accuracy, 99.28% recall, 98.70% F1-score, MCC=0.9746 on RT-IoT-2022, CICIoT-2023, IoMT-2024 benchmarks
comments: The combination of LightGBM-based feature ranking, SHAP explanations, and ADASYN resampling is well-motivated for security applications, though the relational positional encoding novelty is modest relative to standard Linformer.

inputs: network traffic tokens with temporal ordering

outputs: balanced training set with synthetic samples

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relational positional encoding improves temporal dependency capture while maintaining linear attention efficiency
hypotheses.result: LiRPE achieves 99.51% accuracy with reduced computational footprint vs. quadratic attention transformers

hypotheses.hypothesis: SHAP-based feature selection and LightGBM ranking improve interpretability and model robustness
hypotheses.result: Pipeline provides per-sample attributions and global rankings supporting security analyst trust and validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: ADASYN applied only to training data prevents test-set contamination and improves generalization
hypotheses.result: Strict isolation of synthetic samples ensures reliable performance evaluation on unseen intrusions

title: Advanced semi-analytical techniques for fractional shallow water wave models through the analogical structure of generalized $$\phi$$-Caputo derivative operators
task: Develop semi-analytical solution methods for fractional shallow water wave equations with generalized φ-Caputo derivatives
key_results: Two extended methods (φ-CRPSM, φ-CNIM) achieve rapidly convergent solutions with high accuracy and close agreement to integer-order limits; memory-dependent nonlinear dispersive dynamics captured
comments: Strong theoretical framework but lacks experimental validation or benchmark comparison with existing fractional PDE solvers.

model_io.model: Whitham–Broer–Kaup equations with generalized φ-Caputo fractional derivative

hypotheses.hypothesis: φ-Caputo residual power series and new iterative methods generalize classical approaches to broader nonlocal operators
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; methods successfully implemented without linearization or discretization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Solutions exhibit strong convergence and stability for fractional shallow-water systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via numerical illustrations showing effective capture of nonlinear and memory-dependent characteristics

title: Deep learning-assisted ultrathin broadband vanadium dioxide-based polarization-insensitive terahertz metamaterial absorber
task: Design broadband terahertz metamaterial absorber using VO2 with deep learning optimization
key_results: Absorptivity >90% over 2.66–6.48 THz (83.6% relative bandwidth); ultrathin structure 0.328λ × 0.062λ; Residual MLP achieves highest prediction accuracy
comments: Deep learning integration for design optimization is practical but the comparison to traditional optimization methods is absent.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed via broad-angle and polarization-independent absorption demonstration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Residual MLP outperforms standard MLP for absorber design prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with highest R² and lowest error in 5/10-fold cross-validation
